required_changes_v2.concern: v2 ticket contains a reciprocal internal contradiction about how to fill the cost field in a synthesized fallback card. Three places in the ticket are inconsistent: (a) Evidence section lines 106-111 correctly identifies v2 option cost is CNY while PLAN cards use display currency (EUR for this trip); (b) R1 v2 line 298 says 'Never overwrite a display-currency cost (EUR) with a raw CNY number'; BUT (c) Reference Source 'Dev constraint' rule at line 208 says 'cost = opt.cost (already in display currency for this trip per _meal_card → _to_display_cost)' — which is FALSE for this trip. _to_display_cost is the PYTHON build-time converter (scripts/generate-html-interactive.py:97); the v2 option JSON files persist raw CNY values (dinner-2-2 has cost=33.0 with currency_local=CNY; the trip's display_currency=EUR per scripts/lib/html_generator.py:728). When dev follows the more-explicit Reference Source mapping rule (which uses the imperative 'field mapping MUST be'), the synthesized fallback card will display 33 EUR for what is actually 33 CNY (~4.3 EUR at typical rate) — a 7x misrepresentation that affects the user's budget understanding.
required_changes_v2.required_fix: Update Reference Source mapping rule at line 208 to align with R1 v2 anti-CNY-as-EUR clause. Concretely, replace 'cost = opt.cost (already in display currency for this trip per _meal_card → _to_display_cost)' with one of two options: (option A — preferred when PLAN alternative exists): 'cost = existingPlanAlternative.cost if a matching PLAN_DATA alternative card exists for opt.option_id or opt.name (this is the value already in display currency, as it was computed by _meal_card at page-build time); fall through to (option B) only when no PLAN alternative exists.' (option B — fallback synthesis only): 'cost = null OR a placeholder UI string like opt.cost.toFixed(0) + opt.currency_local — display the raw value with its currency label rather than silently treating CNY as EUR'. Also add a new AC (e.g. AC9b for the seeded accommodation-1-2 path where no PLAN alternative exists): when the synthesized fallback card renders, either the cost field is hidden/null OR it shows the raw value with currency_local suffix; the rendered Kanban card MUST NOT display a bare numeric value 50 that would be visually indistinguishable from EUR (the accommodation Kanban render at react_template.tpl:1242-1297 does not display cost per the ticket's Evidence note, so this AC may be satisfiable by ensuring no cost is shown on Day 1 accommodation cards). Update R1 v2 'Card-content selection precedence' to make this anti-CNY-as-EUR enforcement testable.

advisories.concern: findSelectedOption cross-day fallback at ticket line 284 scans editorTripData.days[*].slots[*].options[*] by option_id alone. If two days ever contain the same option_id, the lookup returns the first match (or first matching slot) — non-deterministic resolution. Current fixture uses day-N-M naming convention (e.g., dinner-1-2 vs dinner-2-2) which is unique by construction, so this is not a current bug.
advisories.advisory_only_reason: Not blocking for this cycle because: (1) the existing fixture's naming convention guarantees uniqueness; (2) cross-day fallback is reached ONLY when the bridge hasn't yet copied (an edge case the ticket explicitly cites at line 285); (3) the user's verbatim complaint is about visible-card-doesn't-change in the current Yunnan trip, not about hypothetical duplicate option_ids. Hardening can defer to a future cycle.

spec_text_vs_execution_drift_finding.details: v2 ticket internally contradicts itself on the cost-field synthesis rule. The Reference Source mapping rule at line 208 ('cost = opt.cost (already in display currency for this trip per _meal_card → _to_display_cost)') is FALSE for the v2 data files: dev will read the raw v2 option JSON, NOT the _meal_card-converted PLAN card output. _meal_card is a Python-side build-time converter; it has already converted CNY→EUR by the time the PLAN card ships. But the v2 option JSON files persist raw CNY. So opt.cost = 33.0 (CNY) for dinner-2-2, while the trip's display_currency = EUR. Dev following line 208 would synthesize a card with cost=33 displayed as EUR. R1 v2 line 298 says 'Never overwrite a display-currency cost (EUR) with a raw CNY number' but the Reference Source mapping rule is the explicit recipe dev will follow.
spec_text_vs_execution_drift_finding.fix_required: Update line 208 to either: prefer PLAN_DATA alternative card's cost (the actual already-converted value), or display raw with currency_local suffix, or omit cost in fallback synthesis. R1 v2 already mandates 'prefer the existing PLAN_DATA alternative card... for image/cost/notes' (line 292-298) but the Reference Source mapping rule at line 208 contradicts this fallback path. Align the two.
